About.title:
What’s & Why

SikaAI
About.intro:
We aim to stop educational polarization!

As AI spreads, a gap is opening between people who know how to use it and people who don’t. Those with the skills are learning and working faster, while learners without access or guidance risk falling further behind.
About.tagline: SikaAI was built to pull everyone forward.
About.program: SikaAI is an AI literacy program designed first for school students in Nepal (primary and secondary, K-12), and open to youth, adults, and older community members too. In four weeks, learners build the skills to understand AI-generated content, use AI safely, and apply it in everyday life. Lessons use simple language and examples from Nepali life, and work offline once installed, so there are no age limits and no need for a constant connection. Anyone, from anywhere, can learn from it.
About.closing: We can’t stop the rise of AI, but together, we can bridge the gap.

komalhari.skills: Project Management, Frontend Dev & Curriculum Design

seed.title: Seeds need a night’s sleep
seed.body: You plant a seed and water it today. Digging it up tomorrow to check won’t make it grow faster. Your brain is the same: it grows what you learned while you sleep.

momos.title: Don’t eat all the momos at once!
momos.body: You could eat {all, number} momos in one go, but you’d get a tummy ache and forget how good they were. {daily, number} momos a day is much happier. Lessons work the same way.

cricket.title: Champions practise a little every day
cricket.body: A cricket player who practises {minutes, number} minutes every day gets better than one who plays {hours, number} hours on Saturday only. Small and daily beats big and rare.

backpack.title: Your brain is a backpack
backpack.body: Sleep is when your brain packs today’s lessons neatly into the backpack. If you keep stuffing things in, they get messy and fall out.

song.title: Like learning a song
song.body: Play a new song {times, number} times in one night and your fingers forget it by morning. Play it a little each day and soon you know it by heart.
